        </div>
      </article>

          <p class="reading-source">Çetinkaya-Rundel and Hardin</p>
          <h3>Introduction to Modern Statistics</h3>
          <p>Complement for numerical exploration, inference, statistical intuition and applied interpretation.</p>
          <div class="reading-actions"><a href="https://openintro-ims.netlify.app/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the book</a></div>
        </div>

    <div class="reading-map">
      <article><h3>Module 01</h3><p><a href="#r4ds">R for Data Science</a> for the workflow and <a href="#quarto-docs">Quarto</a> for the HTML report.</p></article>
      <article><h3>Module 02</h3><p>R for Data Science: visualization, transformation, exploration, spreadsheets and first numerical summaries.</p></article>
      <article><h3>Module 03</h3><p>R for Data Science: strings and recoding guidance for categorical variables.</p></article>
      <article><h3>Module 04</h3><p>R for Data Science: import, tidy data, factors, spreadsheets and nested data.</p></article>
      <article><h3>Module 05</h3><p>Exploratory data analysis, dates and tidy organization for studying relationships between variables.</p></article>
      <article><h3>Module 06</h3><p><a href="#github-docs">GitHub Docs</a>, Quarto inline code and joins with R for Data Science.</p></article>
      <article><h3>Module 07</h3><p>Communication with R for Data Science and reflection on the limits of visualization.</p></article>
      <article><h3>Module 08</h3><p>Web scraping with R for Data Science to understand HTML, CSS and extraction.</p></article>
      <article><h3>Module 09</h3><p>Targeted review of prediction, validation and bias concepts in the module material.</p></article>
      <article><h3>Module 10</h3><p><a href="#tidytext">Text Mining with R</a>, flexdashboard documentation and Shiny documentation.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>
